name: Lemon ~Kageetei Nostalgia~
original_name: 檸檬 ～影絵亭ノスタルジヤ～
source:
Our guy likes a girl working in his uncle's cafe. Once he got ownership of the cafe from his uncle, he found out the this cafe is special and the girls do extra work. He put a stop to that and now 5 girls only serve him at night. Can he go from H to love?

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161210003249/http://www.members.shaw.ca/lisun/jhag-wng.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
translation:
主角愛上了一名在叔叔咖啡館工作的成年女性。從叔叔手中接管咖啡館後，他發現這裡並不普通，店裡的女孩們還從事額外服務。他制止了這種做法，如今五名成年女性只在夜裡服侍他一人。他們的關係能否從肉體發展成愛情？

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161210003249/http://www.members.shaw.ca/lisun/jhag-wng.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
